# Each line ending in `# ERROR <code>` must be rejected by pyrefly with exactly that code; every other line must be accepted.
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import assert_never

from any_pipeline import Failed, Limit, Ok, Outcome, Stage, gather

L = Limit(calls=1, seconds=1.0, tries=1)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Audio:
    path: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Words:
    n: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Turns:
    k: int


async def hear(a: Audio) -> Words:
    return Words(1)


async def diar(a: Audio) -> Turns:
    return Turns(1)


async def label(p: tuple[Words, Turns]) -> int:
    return p[0].n


async def count(w: Words) -> int:
    return w.n


def not_async(a: Audio) -> Words:
    return Words(1)


H, D, T, C = Stage("hear", hear, L), Stage("diar", diar, L), Stage("label", label, L), Stage("count", count, L)

fine = gather(H, D) >> T
wrong_edge = H >> T  # ERROR unsupported-operation
mixed_inputs = gather(H, C)  # ERROR bad-argument-type
no_limit = Stage("x", hear)  # ERROR missing-argument
sync_function = Stage("y", not_async, L)  # ERROR bad-argument-type


def handle(o: Outcome[int]) -> int:
    match o:
        case Ok(_, value):
            return value
        case _:
            assert_never(o)  # ERROR bad-argument-type


def edit(a: Audio) -> None:
    a.path = "other"  # ERROR read-only
